turns.replyText:
Between your top two gift ideas, which feels more special?
The FASS Motorsports Graffiti Hoodie ($60.00) stands out as extra special because of its unique vintage mineral-wash finish. Since each piece undergoes an individual wash process, no two hoodies are exactly alike, giving it a custom, one-of-a-kind feel right out of the package. Combined with the bold multi-color graffiti logo on the back, ultra-soft fleece interior, and a subtle American flag accent on the sleeve, it makes a really thoughtful and memorable gift.
The FASS Motorsports 100 Shots Hoodie ($60.00) is also a fantastic choice if you're looking for a classic black heavyweight fleece with a high-impact, 7-color screen-printed graphic on the back.
